login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Airlink account (Microsoft 365) or a local account.
login.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.entra: Microsoft sign-in failed. Please try again.
errors.disabled: Your account is disabled. Contact IT.

selectPanel.title: Where to?
selectPanel.subtitle: Your account can open these panels.
selectPanel.empty: Your account has no role yet. Ask IT or Security to assign one.

devicesPage.title: Kiosk devices
devicesPage.intro: Each security tablet or PC is enrolled once with a code. Afterwards guards sign in with their PIN.
devicesPage.name: Device name
devicesPage.codeHelp: Type it on the kiosk at /guard. Valid for 15 minutes, single use.

membersPage.title: Users and roles
membersPage.intro: Employees sign in with Microsoft; roles are assigned here. Security staff can get an initial kiosk PIN.
membersPage.name: Name
membersPage.pin: Initial kiosk PIN (4 to 8 digits, optional)

errors.pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
errors.exists: That user already has that role at that site.

enroll.title: Enroll this device
enroll.intro: Ask IT for an enrollment code and type it here.

pin.title: Sign in with PIN
pin.noGuards: No security staff with a PIN at this site. Ask IT to set one up.
pin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.

host.title: My visits
host.intro: Invite visitors and approve unannounced arrivals from here.

list.emptyUpcoming: You have no upcoming passes. Create one to invite someone.
list.group: Group of {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

new.title: New pass
new.intro: The visitor gets a link with their QR, the address and arrival instructions.
new.chooseSite: Which site is the visit for?
new.companyHelp: Type the name; it is created if it does not exist.
new.docHelp: We only store a verification code and the last 4 digits. The visitor can fill it in from the link.
new.scheduleHelp: Recurring passes: the QR works only on those days and hours, within the validity range.
new.gatesHelp: Leave empty to allow any gate the policy permits.
new.groupHelp: Above 1, one pass per person is created ("Visitor 2", "Visitor 3"…) which you can rename later.
new.pendingNotice: This visit kind requires {role} approval; the pass stays pending until approved.

errors.missing_doc: This visit kind requires the visitor's ID or passport.
errors.gate_not_allowed: One of the chosen gates is not allowed for this visit kind.
errors.company_blocked: That company is blocked. Contact Security.
errors.window_order: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.window_past: The validity window has already ended.
errors.schedule: Pick at least one day and a valid time range.

detail.title: Pass for {name}
detail.linkHelp: Share it on WhatsApp or email. It includes the QR, the address and instructions.
detail.name: Visitor name
detail.docMissing: Pending (the visitor fills it in from the link)
detail.groupMembers: {count, plural, one {# pass in this group} other {# passes in this group}}
detail.pendingNotice: Pending {role} approval. We will let you know when it is answered.

ok.created: Pass created. Share the link with the visitor.
ok.createdGroup: {count} passes created. Share each link with its visitor.

errors.invalid: Could not save. Check the data.

approvalsPage.title: Pending approvals
approvalsPage.intro: Passes that need your approval before the visitor can enter.

ok.approved: Pass approved. The host has been notified.
ok.denied: Pass denied. The host has been notified.

approvalsPage.error: Could not process it. Someone else may have answered already.

password.title: Password
password.wrong: The current password is not correct.

pin.title: Kiosk PIN
pin.help: Used on the security tablets. 4 to 8 digits.
pin.invalid: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.uri: Add this key to your authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator) and confirm with a code.

visitor.title: Visitor pass
visitor.instructions: Show this pass and your ID at security when you arrive.
visitor.privacy: Your data is used only for access control. Read the privacy notice.

qr.help: Show this code at the entrance.
qr.rotating: This code changes every 30 seconds; keep the page open when you arrive.
qr.offline: Offline. Reload the page to get a fresh code.
qr.pending: The QR will appear once the pass is approved.
qr.unavailable: This pass is no longer valid.

prereg.title: Complete your details
prereg.intro: It makes your entry faster. We only store a verification code of your document and its last 4 digits.

nda.title: Visitor policy
nda.intro: You must accept this policy to enter.
nda.accept: I have read and accept the visitor policy
nda.name: Type your full name as signature
nda.accepted: You accepted the visitor policy on {date}.

errors.invalid: Check the data and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.closed: This pass no longer accepts changes.

visit.label: Visit
visit.help: Meeting or general visit. ID and badge.

candidate.label: Candidate
candidate.help: HR interview. Badge and escort; no access to production.

contractor.label: Contractor
contractor.help: Technician, maintenance or construction. ID, Security approval, escort and NDA.

vendor.label: Vendor
vendor.help: Supplier or salesperson. ID and badge.

auditor.label: Auditor
auditor.help: Assurant, AT&T, Samsung or certification body. Management approval, NDA and escort.

carrier.label: Carrier
carrier.help: Truck at the dock. Plate and company required; no badge.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.help: Parcels or food. No ID; stays at reception.

recurring.label: Recurring
recurring.help: Cleaning, external security, regular driver. Days and hours, Security approval and rotating QR.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the link or go back home.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Try again. If it keeps failing, tell IT.
